hints.text: Two ratios are equivalent when the same multiplier works on both parts. Compare the first numbers, then compare the second numbers.
From $3$ to $9$ is times $3$. Check whether $4$ times that same $3$ gives the second number, $12$.
$3 \times 3 = 9$ and $4 \times 3 = 12$, so yes, the ratios are equivalent (choice A).

explanation: To test for equivalence, look for one number that multiplies both parts of the first ratio to give the second.
The first parts give $9 \div 3 = 3$, and the second parts give $12 \div 4 = 3$.
Both parts were multiplied by the same number, $3$, so the ratio did not change.
Yes, $3 : 4$ is equivalent to $9 : 12$, which is choice A.
